issues.title: Windows-only Sha256 lacks platform guards
issues.description: The HashAlgorithm::Sha256 variant is only used for Windows-specific WIX tooling downloads but lacks #[cfg(target_os = "windows")] guards. Platform-specific code should use conditional compilation attributes to ensure it only compiles on supported platforms.
issues.rule_name: Platform-Specific Code Must Use Appropriate Conditional Compilation

issues.title: GitHub mirror URL ignored, always downloads from original URL
issues.description: The function `generate_github_alternative_url` computes an alternative mirror URL from environment variables but then returns the original GitHub URL instead of the computed mirror URL. This breaks the GitHub mirror functionality that users configure via `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` or `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE` environment variables. When GitHub has rate limits or accessibility issues, the configured mirrors will be silently ignored and downloads will fail from the original GitHub URLs. The bug occurs because `alt_url` is renamed to `_alt_url` (indicating it's unused) and `url.to_owned()` is returned instead of `alt_url`.

issues.title: Version mismatch between CLI and Tauri core in metadata
issues.description: The metadata-v2.json file incorrectly declares tauri core version as "2.9.3" when the actual Tauri runtime version remains at "2.9.2" (as confirmed in Cargo.lock). This PR only updates tauri-cli and tauri-bundler to 2.9.3, not the core Tauri runtime. This metadata file is used by the CLI to verify version compatibility and inform users about which versions work together. The incorrect version could lead to confusion about compatibility, failed version checks, or users attempting to use mismatched versions thinking they are compatible.

issues.title: Version bump without corresponding .changes change file in this PR
issues.description: This PR bumps crate versions (and updates changelogs) but deletes all existing entries in `.changes/` and does not add a new change file. Per the rule, user-facing/functional changes requiring a version bump must include a covector change file under `.changes/` documenting the bump and summary.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

issues.title: Version bump without corresponding .changes change file in this PR
issues.description: This PR bumps the `tauri-cli` version to 2.9.3 while removing `.changes/*` entries and not adding any new change file. The version bump indicates release-relevant changes that should be accompanied by a covector change file in `.changes/`.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #14409 - Apply Version Updates From Current Changes

structured_output.summary:
The PR is presented as a release/version-bump PR: it consumes four `.changes` files, bumps `tauri-bundler` to 2.7.3, `tauri-cli` to 2.9.3, `@tauri-apps/cli` to 2.9.3, and updates the Cargo.lock entries and changelogs. It also carries three real code changes: a user-agent fix for bundler/CLI HTTP requests, a rewrite of the GitHub mirror handling in `http_utils.rs`, and removal of the Windows-only `cfg` gate on `HashAlgorithm::Sha256`.

The version and changelog bookkeeping is consistent (Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, package.json, and the changelog entries all agree), but two problems stand out. The mirror rewrite in `generate_github_alternative_url` discards the computed mirror URL and returns the original GitHub URL, which silently disables the `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR` and `..._MIRROR_TEMPLATE` features. Separately, `metadata-v2.json` now advertises `"tauri": "2.9.3"` even though `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` is still at 2.9.2, and that field is used as the dependency version written into new projects by `cargo tauri init`.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The mirror regression is a functional break in the bundler's download path for users on restricted networks, and it is not called out anywhere in the PR description or changelog. The `metadata-v2.json` `tauri` version points at a release that does not exist in this tree, which would make generated projects depend on an unpublished version. Both should be fixed before merge. The user-agent change and the version bookkeeping look correct.

architecture.overview:
`tauri-bundler` is the library that downloads Windows build tools (WiX, NSIS) and bundles apps; `tauri-cli` depends on it and exposes the `cargo tauri` commands. `@tauri-apps/cli` is an npm wrapper that ships the CLI. All HTTP fetches for build tools go through `utils/http_utils.rs`, which builds a `ureq::Agent` and, for `https://github.com/` URLs, can redirect the request to a user-configured mirror via two environment variables. Version metadata is consumed by `tauri-cli` at compile time through `metadata-v2.json`, which feeds `init`, `info`, and `plugin init`.

This PR does not change that structure. It bumps versions, attaches the BUNDLER_USER_AGENT to requests that previously used the default agent, rewrites the mirror helper so it no longer returns the mirror URL, and drops a `cfg` gate on the SHA-256 hash variant.
steps: Entry point: `cargo tauri` / `tauri-bundler` calls `download_and_verify` (WiX in `msi/mod.rs`, NSIS in `nsis/mod.rs`), which calls `download` in `http_utils.rs`.

`create_agent_and_url` decides the agent and URL: if `generate_github_alternative_url` returns Some, it uses a configured agent and the returned URL, otherwise it falls back to `base_ureq_agent()` and the original URL.
Changed in this PR: the alternative-URL branch now builds the agent with the bundler user-agent but returns the original `url` rather than the mirror URL it computed, so the mirror is never fetched.
Changed in this PR: the alternative-URL branch sets a user-agent, but `base_ureq_agent()` already does the same, so the real behavioural change is only the lost mirror URL.

Version metadata: `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json` is `include_str!`'d into the CLI and used as the default `tauri` dependency version for new projects; this PR bumps its `tauri` field without a matching `crates/tauri` version bump.
Release bookkeeping: the four `.changes/*.md` files are removed, changelogs are generated, and Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, and package.json are bumped to match.

findings.title: Mirror URL is computed and then discarded, disabling the GitHub mirror feature
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs`, `generate_github_alternative_url` (around lines 49-61) discards the mirror URL: the closure parameter is `_alt_url` and the returned tuple uses `url.to_owned()`. Restore the original behaviour: rename the parameter back to `alt_url` and return `alt_url` as the second tuple element, keeping the `BUNDLER_USER_AGENT` agent builder as is. Consider adding a unit test that sets `TAURI_BUNDLER_TOOLS_GITHUB_MIRROR_TEMPLATE` and asserts the returned URL is the mirror URL, following the existing `test_generate_mirror_url_correctly` pattern.

findings.title: metadata-v2.json advertises tauri 2.9.3 but crates/tauri is still 2.9.2
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, the `"tauri"` field was changed from `2.9.2` to `2.9.3`, but `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` is still at version `2.9.2`. That field is read by `init.rs`, `info/mod.rs`, and `plugin/init.rs` to pick the `tauri` dependency version for generated projects. Either revert the `tauri` value to `2.9.2`, or confirm that the core `tauri` crate is being released at 2.9.3 and bump `crates/tauri/Cargo.toml` (and related lockfile entries) in the same change. Leave `cli.js` and `tauri-build`/`tauri-plugin` as they are unless the release requires otherwise.

findings.title: Unrelated code change slipped into a version-bump PR
findings.body:
The PR description and changelogs describe only version bumps and the listed fixes, but the diff also removes `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]` from `HashAlgorithm::Sha256` and from its `verify_hash` match arm. This is not in any `.changes` entry. The change is probably harmless, since `sha2` is an unconditional dependency and the enum is `allow(dead_code)`, but it changes the public-ish surface of the module on non-Windows targets and should be called out in the changelog or split into its own PR so the release notes stay accurate.

::diff{file="crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs" lines="98-100"}
findings.fixPrompt: In `crates/tauri-bundler/src/utils/http_utils.rs`, the `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]` attributes were removed from the `HashAlgorithm::Sha256` variant (around line 99) and its match arm in `verify_hash`. Either restore the gates if Sha256 should stay Windows-only, or keep the removal and add a `.changes` entry or a changelog note explaining why it is now available on all platforms. Confirm the change is intentional and not an accidental side effect of the mirror edit.

findings.title: User-agent is now applied to build-tool downloads
findings.body: Requests fetched through `create_agent_and_url` now carry `BUNDLER_USER_AGENT`, which is `tauri-bundler/<version>`. That value comes from `CARGO_PKG_VERSION` and stays in sync with the Cargo.toml bump. The default `base_ureq_agent()` already sets the same user-agent, so the normal path is consistent. The version bumps in Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, package.json, and the changelogs match each other, and `tauri-cli` correctly depends on `tauri-bundler` 2.7.3.
